sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mfehas.client_id)
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary mfehas
                    FROM mamba_fact_transfer_in
         INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp ON mfehas.client_id = mdp.patient_id
         INNER JOIN mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card mfehac ON mfehac.client_id = mfehas.client_id
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT client_id
                    WHERE transfer_in_date >= :startDate AND transfer_in_date <= :endDate) mfti
                   ON mfti.client_id = mfehas.client_id
WHERE baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate
  AND baseline_regimen_start_date <= :endDate
  AND baseline_cd4 < 200
  AND mfehac.crag_test_results LIKE '%positive%'
  AND mfehac.medication_or_other_side_effects='Aspergillosis'
  AND mfehac.encounter_date >= :startDate
  AND mfehac.encounter_date <= :endDate
  AND mfti.client_id IS NULL
